primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: A deliberately small formal proof lane with four independent targets. It checks that equality of all declared finite probe observations is an equivalence relation, that implication between the induced indistinguishability relations gives a refinement preorder, that the associator vanishes for named concrete 2x2 complex matrices, and that named concrete Pauli matrices obey the three cyclic commutator equalities. The Lean declarations and axiom reports are the outputs; they do not stand in for the owner's larger foundational or physics program.
primary_object_card.object_statement: The LEAN MICRO-CORE lane formalizes exactly four bounded statements: probe-indistinguishability equivalence, probe-family refinement preorder, a concrete complex 2x2 matrix associator control, and concrete Pauli commutator closure.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Frozen exact targets, pass rules, block rules, required artifacts, and no-physics ceiling.

native_terms.probe-indistinguishable: Every declared probe returns the same observation on the two states.
native_terms.refines: Indistinguishability under the fine family implies indistinguishability under the coarse family.
native_terms.associator control: The difference (A*B)*C - A*(B*C) for concrete complex 2x2 matrices.
native_terms.Pauli closure: The three concrete cyclic matrix commutators under [A,B]=A*B-B*A.

weirdness_signature: finiteness is declared for the probe carrier even though equivalence itself does not consume enumeration
refinement is a preorder on observational power and does not assert syntactic antisymmetry
matrix associativity is only the associative control for a separate nonassociativity program
Pauli relations are concrete matrix equalities and carry no physics admission
primary_object_card.domain: finite Lean state/probe types for T1-T2 and Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) Complex for T3-T4
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: Lean theorem declarations plus #print axioms and fresh build receipts
allowed_operations: multiply subtract and scalar-multiply concrete matrices
required_invariants: all four targets retain their exact bounded statements
each target remains in its own Lean file
blocked infrastructure is reported rather than replaced by prose
the associative control is not reframed as a nonassociativity result
the Pauli control is not reframed as physics admission
forbidden_substitutions: numerical floating-point checks as a proxy replacement for Lean equality proofs
custom unproved axioms or labels replacing matrix infrastructure
a partial-order claim replacing the requested preorder
proof of the larger ten-target program
negative_controls: reject antisymmetry on differently presented but observationally equivalent families
retain the explicit commutator sign convention
block T3-T4 if compatible Matrix/Complex infrastructure is unavailable
inspect #print axioms so hidden custom axioms cannot be silently admitted
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: Lean is an adapter for exact theorem checking only; the Matrix and Pauli carriers preserve the named algebraic equalities but lose all larger physical and program-level context.
promotion_locks: no Axis bridge or manifold admission
no claim beyond four exact theorem statements
no canonical-by-process claim from a local build alone
blocked_downstream_consumers: completion of the ten foundational targets

lateral_mappings.label: Lean core relation checker
lateral_mappings.target: T1 and T2 finite probe relations
loses: any interpretation beyond the declared observation function
lateral_mappings.kill_control: if the Lean theorem differs from the frozen quantifiers or implication direction, reject the adapter receipt

lateral_mappings.label: mathlib complex matrix probe
lateral_mappings.target: T3 and T4 concrete Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) Complex equalities
lateral_mappings.kill_control: if compatible infrastructure is unavailable or a custom axiom is introduced, mark T3-T4 blocked

root_constraints: finite declared carrier/probe sets for observational targets
order-sensitive concrete matrix multiplication and commutators for controls
extended_constraints: mathlib Matrix and Complex availability through the read-only physlib estate

fixation_breakers: if mathlib integration fails, keep core T1-T2 and block T3-T4 rather than widening the task
compare theorem statements directly to frozen card before accepting build green

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair only the first theorem/toolchain mismatch without weakening the frozen target
loop_contract.stop_condition: card, exact source files, fresh build_log.txt, and results_v1.json are frozen, or an unavailable dependency is recorded as blocked

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question asks for an answer; it is not authorization to implement unless the user explicitly says to do it.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Any sequence or ordering claim must be checked separately from content correctness, with the order witness named.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: When debugging runtime behavior, preserve the tuned visible/output baseline and debug the execution path underneath.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: A Popper pass names the target claim, strongest live falsifier, decisive check, and killed/open/survived classification before agreement.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: A Feynman pass names the operation, the observable measured, and the pass/fail condition.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must name distinct receipts and explicitly refuse the merge, sequence, or reframe it is not performing.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve with tools before asking; ask the human only for private, preference-bound, or unrecoverable information.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Current Wizard v4.3 object-preservation guard; historical v4.2 surfaces are not the run target.

source_math_locks.preserves: the exact four theorem targets, block rules, artifacts, and claim ceiling

evidence_spine.claim_ceiling: machine-checked statements at their exact stated scope after fresh local rerun; no physics, Axis, bridge, manifold, nonassociativity, or ten-target admission
blocked_consumers: canonical-by-process status without independent repo gates
